lines.speaker: Guru
lines.text: “I don’t care who you are! Now clean my jowls!”

lines.speaker: Guru
lines.text: And that was Nail’s first day on the job.

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: Yes sir, I remember; I was there. That also doesn’t have anything to do with what we were talking about.

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: That ungodly POWER headed our way!

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: You know, perhaps you should give someone *else* that power-up?

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: You remember - the one you gave the Earthlings?

lines.speaker: Guru
lines.text: You are correct. It is time for me to unlock your hidden powers… Dende.

lines.speaker: Guru
lines.text: And now, your power has been awakened.

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: Sir, I was referring to ME!

lines.speaker: Guru
lines.text: With these powers, you garner a huge responsibility.

lines.speaker: Guru
lines.text: I need you to run as fast as you can to the Earthlin—

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: Sir, he left you the moment after you gave him the power-up.

lines.speaker: Jeice
lines.text: ...Then out of nowhere, this *stupid* guy in this *stupid* outfit starts beating us up and I lost me best mate and–!

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: Jeice! You’ll speak to me professionally and dutifully.

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: Now, Jeice, back from the field. Full report!

lines.speaker: Jeice
lines.text: Well, see, at first it was going fine, but next thing we know, Guldo, well…

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: Oh Lord, he’s dead, isn’t he?

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: Well, in our line of work, our lives can be compromised at any moment. This is something we must live with.

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: On the plus side, Burter owes me 50 Raditz.

lines.speaker: Jeice
lines.text: Aaabout that, Cap'n - he’s probably not gonna pay up.

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: Really? He’s usually such a good sport about that.

lines.speaker: Jeice
lines.text: Thing is, he’s come down with a sudden case of death, sir.

lines.speaker: Jeice
lines.text: Yes, sir. He was a valued teammate. Strong, fast, and—

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: Blue! And tall! And you're so red! And short!

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: It was the perfect little yin-yang thing we had going.

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: Oh, don’t go all Vegeta on me.

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: Now, where are we going to find another blue recruit? Perhaps Recoome knows someone?

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: Well, did he at least die with dignity?

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: Well, Jeice, I believe the next step is obvious.

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: We, as professionals, cannot allow this act to go unabated.

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: We have a job to finish, and we shall see it through.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Sure is nice to see you guys again. But I sure can’t help but feel that someone’s missing...

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: What do you think she’s up to?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Your idiotic banter is charming, but if you haven’t noticed, we’re pretty much screwed here.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Freeza has the Dragon Balls, you *dolt*, which basically means we’re already dead!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Oh? Something you know that I don’t?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: ...You have five seconds to rephrase that...

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Actually what I meant to say was when you make a wish on the Dragon Balls, the sky turns darker than the *blackest* void…

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: ...and out of the balls rises a *giant dragon*!

lines.speaker: Jeice
lines.text: That’s him, Cap’n! That’s the one who beat us up!

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: *What*? Just look at his hair! He looks like he just got out of bed! For goodness sakes, Jeice, he’s even wearing pajamas!

lines.speaker: Jeice
lines.text: I swear it, sir! He picked us apart one by one! We never stood a cha—!

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: Jeice, what have I told you?!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: You know, I’m surprised you’re here, Ginyu. I thought you’d be busy polishing Freeza’s boots.

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: * First off, Lord Freeza doesn’t wear boots. * Second, if he did, I’d have already polished them. * Third, he’s off chasing some leftover Namekians.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Wait, so Freeza’s not at the ship?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: And the average power level of Freeza’s soldiers is…

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Krillin! Gohan! Get out of here and find Bulma.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Vegeta and I can handle this on our own.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Oh, no! I mean, I’d really hate to leave you on your own, you know but if you say so, LET’S GO, GOHAN!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: All right, Vegeta. We have to put our differences aside for now, and take these guys as a team.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Yeah, that’s fantastic and entertaining and all that, but first, if you don’t mind me, I need to use the restroom.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: 'So, for the first century, I’ll go easy on them, lure them into a false sense of security; and then when they think I’m not so bad, BAM! I’ll go full tyrant on them in the second century! After that, I’ll disappear for a millennia and make them wonder if I ever existed to begin with... just to come back and kill them all.'

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Ah, good sir. I suppose you could say I’m looking for "technical support".

lines.speaker: Guru
lines.text: Naaaail! Do we have a visitor?

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: He doesn’t have a coat, sir. And I believe this is the man who basically killed our entire race.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: You see, I recently acquired what you people refer to as “Dragon Balls”, but I’m having trouble getting them to do what I want.

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: Did you try working the shaft?

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: He’s asking how to use the Dragon Balls.

lines.speaker: Guru
lines.text: Did you tell him to work the shaft?

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: I have the distinct impression you’re going to be difficult.

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: Well, sir, if you’re having a problem with our customer support, you can call 1-800-EAT-A-D**K.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Okay, this is getting ridiculous. What *is* that?

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: *Good Lord*, I was led to believe your species survived entirely on water! How is he so FAT?!

lines.speaker: Guru
lines.text: Oh, hello. I’m Super Kami Guru, and I’m the guy who’s *not* judging you on your appearance.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Well, my name is Freeza, ruler of most of the known galaxy. I’m here to offer you a deal.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: You give me the information I require, and I’ll let the sporting young man live.

lines.speaker: Guru
lines.text: Pleeease. Nail isn’t afraid of you. He is the strongest of our race!

lines.speaker: Guru
lines.text: Yeah. Nail’s gonna *destroy* your sorry ass. They wouldn’t be able to air it on the news because it’ll be SO BRUTAL!

lines.speaker: Guru
lines.text: Hush, Nail! I’m speaking for you.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Well, then. If this is the only course of action available to me, I accept.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: I’ll dispatch of this worm, and then I’ll be back for *you*, *slug*.

lines.speaker: Guru
lines.text: Leave my brother out of this!

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: Sir, his power is overwhelming! I can also sense it’s only a fraction of what he’s capable of!

lines.speaker: Guru
lines.text: You are Namek’s number one son. A prodigy child.

lines.speaker: Guru
lines.text: You have been trained in the ancient ways. I believe in you.

lines.speaker: Guru
lines.text: Yes, Nail. Now show him the staggering spirit of Namek, and waste his smug ass!

lines.speaker: Guru
lines.text: Fool. If I had trained him in the *new* way, he might’ve stood a chance...

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: You have an interesting form, and a surprisingly well-honed technique.

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: I’m sufficiently impressed! You’ve held your own very well.

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: But your form and grace will never compare to that of the illustrious CAPTAIN GINYU!

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: Oh, God! Is that what I look like?!

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: Jeice! That isn’t what I look like, is it?!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: No offense, but this is boring.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Like, listening to Gohan’s piano recital boring.

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: I realize these poses in an effort to invigorate my men and raise morale!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Well, I mean, it’s just, I’m not even using half my power right now.

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: Ahaahhhhh. Quite a substantial bluff! But a bluff, and nothing more.

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: I’ve witnessed your abilities first hand, and I assure you that you’re—

lines.speaker: Jeice
lines.text: Oy, Cap’n! Isn’t your max power level only one hundred and—

lines.speaker: Jeice
lines.text: ...Yeah, one hundred and twenty thousand. That’s what I thought.

lines.speaker: Jeice
lines.text: Eh, the Cap’n? Yeah, he just does that sometimes.

lines.speaker: Jeice
lines.text: Well, Cap’n, if you’re gettin’ stressed, you could always… you know...

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: *Oh, Jeice*! This is hardly the time or the place!

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: Besides, I did it in the pod on the way here.

lines.speaker: Jeice
lines.text: Uh… I meant switch bodies, sir...

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: Ah yes, of course! Hold my Scouter.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Hey, what’re you doing with your hand?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Um, sir? You’re supposed to do that to me.

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: Ohh-ho, but you see... I DID do it to you!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: 'Oh, wow… what happened? Everything seems… weird...'

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: '...oh, hey! There’s another me over there! I wonder if—'

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: They make a special shampoo for that, I hear.

segments.title: Now Clean My Jowls
segments.quote: “I don’t care who you are! Now clean my jowls!” And that was Nail’s first day on the job.

segments.title: That SLUT!
segments.quote: It is time for me to unlock your hidden powers… Dende. / AH, WHAT THE HELL?! ... That SLUT!

segments.title: A Sudden Case of Death
segments.quote: Thing is, he’s come down with a sudden case of death, sir. / Oh... that's... wow...

segments.title: You Have Five Seconds
segments.quote: ...You have five seconds to rephrase that... 4... 3... / ...2... 1... / Hi, Vegeta.

segments.title: He's Even Wearing Pajamas
segments.quote: Just look at his hair! He looks like he just got out of bed! For goodness sakes, Jeice, he’s even wearing pajamas!

segments.title: Freeza's Long Game
segments.quote: '...BAM! I’ll go full tyrant on them in the second century!'

segments.title: Did You Try Working the Shaft?
segments.quote: Did you try working the shaft? / *Classy*. ... you can call 1-800-EAT-A-D**K. / We don’t even haaave those!!

segments.title: NATURAL LIGHT!
segments.quote: Oh, God! NATURAL LIIIGHT! / How is he so FAT?!

segments.title: SO BRUTAL
segments.quote: Nail’s gonna *destroy* your sorry ass. They wouldn’t be able to air it on the news because it’ll be SO BRUTAL!

segments.title: Is That What I Look Like?!
segments.quote: And you’re purple! ... CAPTAIN GINYU! / You mean, like this? / Oh, God! Is that what I look like?!

segments.title: A Hundred and Eighty Thousand
segments.quote: A hundred and eighty thousand! / Isn’t your max power level only one hundred and— / D'AAAUUUUGGHH!!

segments.title: CHANGE NOW
segments.quote: You’re supposed to do that to me. / Ohh-ho, but you see... I DID do it to you! CHANGE NOOOWWWW!
